zh.name: 按任务选工具清单
zh.summary: 把工具放回具体任务，每页用真实界面、适用工作和选择理由说明该用哪个。
zh.useWhen: 任务是比较轴；区别于只罗列网址的资源清单。入门与进阶、任务排名合并为同一模板的变体。
zh.instructions: 任务、候选工具、实际界面、使用条件与价格核验日期
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Tools by Task List
en.summary: Create an Instagram list carousel using the tools by task list structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the tools by task list format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
